conditions: Thermia Fractures only run while the event is active; check the World State Window.
Points carry over between event windows, so partial progress is never lost.
Get canisters from Coolant Raknoids or the Exploiter Orb patrolling the Temple of Profit.
bonuses: Feed up to three more canisters in the first 30 seconds to score more per fracture.
Filling the leftover Diluted Thermia lets you summon the Exploiter Orb for Hildryn parts.

disclosures.title: reward track
disclosures.body: 5 points: emblem. 25: Amalgam Shotgun Barrage + Amalgam Serration. 50: Amalgam Barrel Diffusion + Amalgam Organ Shatter. 75: sigil. 100: Opticor Vandal with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Each tier is a one-time reward.
